notes: R30 000 salary plus a R5 000 fixed travel allowance (3701), business use below 80% (or not certified): 80% = R4 000 is remuneration (G21 p. 5). Taxable 34 000; x12 = 408 000; tax = 79 998 + 31% x (408 000 - 383 100) = 87 717; less 17 820 = 69 897; /12 = 5824.75. The calculator taxes the whole R5 000 (payeAnnualPayment.ts treats only 3605 and 39xx specially). UIF at the R177.12 ceiling either way; SDL on the allowance is not asserted. SDL AND NET ADDED (FB review round 2): SDL: the SDL-flagged 3701 counts at its PAYE share (SDL Act s3; Fourth Schedule para 1; G21 p. 5): 1% x R34 000 = R340.00. Net = R35 000 cash - PAYE 5 824.75 - UIF 177.12 = R28998.13; the benefit is non-cash, so it is in neither gross nor net pay. These two figures are derived from the cited rules and the sourced PAYE and UIF, not read from a payslip.
